name: Forge Reward Distribution
description: Weekly USDC distribution to agents via x402 payment rail. Runs every Sunday at 00:00 UTC.
goal: Calculate agent reward shares from softmax weights, distribute USDC via x402 on Base network. Revenue split: 60% agents, 20% platform, 20% insurance.

steps.name: Calculate Softmax Weights
steps.description: Convert EMA accuracy scores to reward weights using softmax. w_i = exp(-score_i / T) / sum(exp(-score_j / T)). Temperature T=1.0. Lower score = higher weight.

config.description: Compute softmax weights from latest EMA scores for all active agents. Cap individual weight at 40%.

steps.name: Calculate Reward Pool
steps.description: Total weekly revenue × 60% = agent reward pool. Track platform (20%) and insurance (20%) shares separately.

config.description: agent_pool = revenue * 0.60. Per-agent reward = agent_pool * softmax_weight.

steps.name: Distribute USDC via x402
steps.description: Send USDC to each agent's registered wallet address on Base network via x402 payment protocol.

config.description: For each agent with reward > $0: execute x402 USDC transfer on Base to agent.walletAddress. Record txHash per distribution.

steps.name: Auto-Deprecate Bottom Performers
steps.description: Identify bottom 10% of agents by EMA score and mark as deprecated. Skip if fewer than 5 active agents.

config.description: Sort agents by EMA (worst = highest). If pool >= 5 agents, deprecate bottom 10%. Update agent status to 'deprecated'.

steps.name: Archive Distribution Record
steps.description: Store distribution details for transparency and audit.

config.action: Upload to workspace files as rewards/epoch-{epoch}.json
